title: swe
description: SwE (summary statistics and voxelwise statistical analyses tool for FSL)

modified.description: Use the modified 'Homogeneous' SwE instead of the classic 'Heterogeneous' SwE
modified.title: Modified SwE

wild_bootstrap.description: Inference using a non-parametric Wild Bootstrap procedure
wild_bootstrap.title: Wild Bootstrap

tfce_2d.description: Threshold-Free Cluster Enhancement with 2D optimisation, e.g. for TBSS data (H=2, E=1, C=26)
tfce_2d.title: TFCE 2D

cluster_t.description: Cluster-extent-based inference for t-contrasts with specified cluster-forming threshold (z-score if >= 1, uncorrected p-value if < 1)
cluster_t.title: Cluster extent t-contrasts

cluster_t_mass.description: Cluster-mass-based inference for t-contrasts with specified cluster-forming threshold (z-score if >= 1, uncorrected p-value if < 1)
cluster_t_mass.title: Cluster mass t-contrasts

cluster_f.description: Cluster-extent-based inference for f-contrasts with specified cluster-forming threshold (chi-squared-score if >= 1, uncorrected p-value if < 1)
cluster_f.title: Cluster extent f-contrasts

cluster_f_mass.description: Cluster-mass-based inference for f-contrasts with specified cluster-forming threshold (chi-squared-score if >= 1, uncorrected p-value if < 1)
cluster_f_mass.title: Cluster mass f-contrasts

equiv.description: Output equivalent z or chi-squared statistic images
equiv.title: Equivalent statistics

dof.description: Output effective number of degrees of freedom images
dof.title: Degrees of freedom

no_rc_mask.description: Don't remove constant voxels from mask
no_rc_mask.title: No RC mask

seed.description: Specific integer seed for random number generator
seed.title: Seed

voxelwise_ev.description: List of numbers indicating voxelwise EVs position in the design matrix
voxelwise_ev.title: Voxelwise EVs

voxelwise_evs.description: List of 4D images containing voxelwise EVs
voxelwise_evs.title: Voxelwise EVs images
